|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olson]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/ivedecidedtogoback.html</ref>

The Used portion seems straightforward, but it can be more useful than you might imagine. Bringing a character back to your hand normally just lets you deploy that character somewhere else next turn, but that's not all you can do with this card. With the variety of political effects that you have at your disposal, you can use this interrupt to bring a character with a matching agenda back to your hand, such as getting Horoxx Ryder to place him on [[Ascertaining The Truth]].

The Lost portion will also be useful. If your opponent invades the senate, you can use this to add a battle destiny, for the small price of losing a couple points of politics. But sometimes politicians will need to leave the senate, and this lets you use them to their fullest potential by adding battle destiny in a crucial battle.

Combos:

2 battle destiny for 3 Force!

Canceling a Force drain and causing your opponent to miss critical weapon shots.
|combos=* [[Queen Amidala]], Ruler of [[Naboo]] + [[I've Decided To Go Back]] (Lost) Two battle destinies for 3 Force!<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=I%27ve%20Decided%20To%20Go%20Back</ref>
* Queen, Amidala, Ruler of [[Naboo]] + [[I've Decided To Go Back]] (Used) + [[Plea To The Court]] Canceling a Force drain and causing your opponent to miss critical weapon shots.
